$comment: Hand-edited decisions merged by npm run buildings:import; never overwritten and not shipped to the browser. Key each entry by the API elementId. Allowed fields: name, aliases (replaces derived search aliases), roomCodePrefixes (replaces computed links), location {x: longitude, y: latitude} (replaces the API centroid), entrance {x, y, osmNode} (a provisional OpenStreetMap entrance; cannot be combined with location), groupKey, partLabel (for example "Blocks 15-17"), blocks (block numbers or letters), groupRole ("entrance" marks a group main-entrance record), and $comment for the reason. unlinkedPrefixes ({prefix: reason}) lists room code prefixes deliberately left unlinked. Unknown elementIds or fields fail the import.
